SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Country = 'CZK' THEN T1.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Country = 'CZK' THEN T1.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Difference
FROM yearmonth AS T1
JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Date LIKE '2013%'
GROUP BY T2.Segment
HAVING T2.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')

SELECT T1.Segment, SUM(T2.Consumption) / SUM(T1.Consumption) * 100 AS PercentageIncrease
FROM customers AS T1
JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
AND T2.Date BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2013-12-31'
GROUP BY T1.Segment
ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC
LIMIT 1
